_about: Core glossary. Owner: supervisor/foundation batch. General terms a learner needs across the whole site. Search this file before you add a term in your own batch file.

cordis.short: The vendored plugin framework under dsh. Plugins contribute services, typed events and reversible effects to a shared context.
cordis.long: Cordis has no privileged core: every part of the product, including the model adapter, the tool registry and the agent loop, is a plugin, so each piece is replaceable from configuration ({{cite docs/architecture.md:9}}, {{cite docs/architecture.md:11}}).

plugin.short: An object that implements Service: a function with inject/apply(ctx), or a Service subclass Cordis mounts into a context.

service.short: What a plugin claims from a context: a stable ctx.<key> such as ctx.tools or ctx.llm, found by key instead of by import.

context.short: A repository of services. A plugin reads another plugin's service through the context instead of importing it directly.

profile.short: A named plugin-tree composition stored in the Harness home. It lists the bundles it stacks and the user's own patch file.
profile.long: Shipped profiles are web, headless, sdk, sdk-minimal and acp, selected with dsh --profile <name> ({{cite docs/architecture.md:17}}, {{cite docs/architecture.md:43}}).

bundle.short: A distribution format for Cordis config rows and the code they mount, so whatever it inserts stays patchable by the layers above it.

turn.short: One drain of admitted input in a session. It opens before its first input is claimed and closes once nothing is owed.
turn.long: A turn contains zero or more steps ({{cite docs/glossary.md:37}}, {{cite docs/architecture.md:81}}).

step.short: One model request plus the tool executions caused by its response. A turn contains zero or more steps.

round.short: An outer policy iteration containing a turn, such as a goal round. Round counters belong to that policy, not to every turn.

exchange.short: Consecutive turns from a turn whose first step admits human input until the next such turn.
exchange.long: Turns woken by notices, such as a settled subagent or a goal round, stay in the preceding exchange ({{cite docs/glossary.md:40}}).

session.short: The durable conversation object: one Session holds one append-only event log and is the identity an agent runs on.

session-log.short: The append-only log of SessionEvent records. It is the source of the context the model sees.
session-log.long: deriveMessages() projects model history from this log ({{cite docs/architecture.md:59}}, {{cite docs/architecture.md:124}}).

agent.short: The live object that drives one session: it owns the turn/step loop and the inbox of pending input.
agent.long: AgentRegistry publishes and tracks live Agents; ReactLoopAgent is the default implementation of the Agent interface ({{cite packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:112}}).

agent-loop.short: The turn/step cycle that claims input, calls the model, runs the tools it asks for, and repeats.

tool-call.short: One request from the model to run a tool, carried through the tools/pre-execute, tools/execute and tools/post-execute pipeline.

subagent.short: A child agent a parent delegates work to through a named provider. A local child keeps a durable session; others execute once.

mcp.short: Model Context Protocol. It connects the model to tools and resources supplied by external servers.

skill.short: An optional, loadable instruction set, discovered through a provider registry under ctx.skills. Not a session event.

sandbox.short: The process-sandbox seam. It wraps a subprocess in a file-effect policy: read-only, workspace-write, or danger-full-access.

acp.short: Agent Client Protocol. The automation-only JSON-RPC-over-stdio protocol the dsh-acp server implements.

capability-seam.short: A swappable capability with three roles: a Service Definition, one or more Service Providers, and one or more Consumers.
capability-seam.long: {{cite docs/architecture.md:136}}. The seam is the complete capability; name a single role by its own name instead ({{cite docs/glossary.md:9}}).

approval-policy.short: The human-in-the-loop decision for one action: may this specific action proceed?

workflow.short: An optional capability that lets an agent run a model-written script that starts subagents. It is not part of the agent loop.

goal.short: One durable completion objective attached to a session, with an active/paused/blocked/complete phase and a goal-round cap.

plan-mode.short: Logged per-agent collaboration state that adds a guidance section to each model request while active. It is soft guidance only.
plan-mode.long: Sandbox mode and approval policy enforce restrictions independently of plan mode ({{cite docs/subsystems/plan.md:5}}).

job.short: A long-running background unit tracked by ctx.jobs, with a status of running, stopping, completed, killed or failed.
